description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: God calls Jeremiah as a prophet to the nations, saying he was chosen before he was born, and touches his mouth to give him God's words. Visions of an almond branch and a boiling pot announce that disaster is coming from the north.
1.sw: Mungu anamwita Yeremia kuwa nabii kwa mataifa, akisema alichaguliwa kabla hajazaliwa, na kukigusa kinywa chake ili kumpa maneno ya Mungu. Maono ya fimbo ya mlozi na chungu kinachochemka yanatangaza kwamba maafa yanakuja kutoka kaskazini.
1.am: እግዚአብሔር ከመወለዱ በፊት እንደ ተመረጠ እየነገረው ኤርምያስን ለሕዝቦች ነቢይ እንዲሆን ይጠራዋል፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ሊሰጠው አፉን ይዳስሰዋል። የለውዝ በትርና የሚፈላ ድስት ራእዮች ጥፋት ከሰሜን እንደሚመጣ ያውጃሉ።

2.en: God remembers Israel's early devotion, but the people have exchanged God, the spring of living water, for cracked cisterns and turned to other gods.
2.sw: Mungu anakumbuka uaminifu wa Israeli wa mwanzo, lakini watu wamembadilisha Mungu, chemchemi ya maji yaliyo hai, kwa mabirika yenye nyufa na kuigeukia miungu mingine.
2.am: እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤልን የቀድሞ ታማኝነት ያስታውሳል፤ ሕዝቡ ግን የሕያው ውኃ ምንጭ የሆነውን እግዚአብሔርን በተሰነጠቁ የውኃ ጉድጓዶች ለውጠዋል፤ ወደ ሌሎች አማልክትም ዞረዋል።

3.en: Judah is like an unfaithful wife, worse than her sister Israel. God calls them to return and promises shepherds after God's own heart.
3.sw: Yuda ni kama mke asiye mwaminifu, mbaya kuliko dada yake Israeli. Mungu anawaita warudi na anaahidi wachungaji wanaoupendeza moyo wa Mungu.
3.am: ይሁዳ ከእኅቷ ከእስራኤል የከፋች እንደማትታመን ሚስት ናት። እግዚአብሔር እንዲመለሱ ይጠራቸዋል፤ እንደ ልቡ የሆኑ እረኞችንም ተስፋ ይሰጣል።

4.en: God calls Judah to break up the unplowed ground and circumcise their hearts. A destroyer is coming from the north, and Jeremiah is anguished at the vision of the land laid waste.
4.sw: Mungu anawaita Yuda walime mashamba yao yasiyolimwa na kuitahiri mioyo yao. Mharibifu anakuja kutoka kaskazini, na Yeremia ana uchungu mkubwa kwa maono ya nchi iliyoharibiwa.
4.am: እግዚአብሔር ይሁዳ ያልታረሰውን መሬታቸውን እንዲያርሱና ልባቸውን እንዲገርዙ ይጠራቸዋል። አጥፊ ከሰሜን ይመጣል፤ ኤርምያስም ምድሪቱ ባድማ በሆነችበት ራእይ እጅግ ይጨነቃል።

5.en: No one in Jerusalem does justice or seeks the truth; prophets prophesy lies and the people love it, so a nation from far away will come against them.
5.sw: Hakuna mtu katika Yerusalemu anayetenda haki wala kutafuta kweli; manabii wanatabiri uongo na watu wanapenda hivyo, kwa hiyo taifa kutoka mbali litakuja dhidi yao.
5.am: በኢየሩሳሌም ፍትሕን የሚያደርግ ወይም እውነትን የሚፈልግ የለም፤ ነቢያት ሐሰትን ይተነብያሉ፤ ሕዝቡም ይወዱታል፤ ስለዚህ ከሩቅ ሕዝብ ይመጣባቸዋል።

6.en: Jerusalem will be besieged because it is full of oppression. The people say "Peace, peace" when there is no peace, and they refuse to walk in the ancient paths.
6.sw: Yerusalemu itazingirwa kwa sababu imejaa dhuluma. Watu wanasema "Amani, amani" wakati hakuna amani, na wanakataa kuenenda katika mapito ya kale.
6.am: ኢየሩሳሌም በግፍ ስለ ተሞላች ትከበባለች። ሕዝቡ ሰላም ሳይኖር «ሰላም፣ ሰላም» ይላሉ፤ በጥንቱ መንገድም ለመሄድ እምቢ ይላሉ።

7.en: At the temple gate Jeremiah warns the people not to trust in the words "the temple of God" while they oppress the weak and follow other gods. God will do to the temple what was done to Shiloh.
7.sw: Kwenye lango la hekalu Yeremia anawaonya watu wasiyatumainie maneno "hekalu la Mungu" wakati wanawaonea wanyonge na kuifuata miungu mingine. Mungu atalitendea hekalu kama alivyopatendea Shilo.
7.am: ኤርምያስ በቤተ መቅደሱ በር ላይ ሆኖ ሕዝቡ ደካሞችን እየጨቈኑና ሌሎች አማልክትን እየተከተሉ «የእግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ» በሚለው ቃል እንዳይታመኑ ያስጠነቅቃቸዋል። እግዚአብሔር በሴሎ እንዳደረገው በቤተ መቅደሱ ላይ ያደርጋል።

8.en: The people hold fast to deceit and do not return. Jeremiah weeps for his people: the harvest is past and they are not saved, and there is no balm in Gilead.
8.sw: Watu wanashikilia udanganyifu na hawarudi. Yeremia anawalilia watu wake: mavuno yamekwisha na hawajaokolewa, na hakuna zeri katika Gileadi.
8.am: ሕዝቡ ተንኰልን አጥብቀው ይይዛሉ፤ አይመለሱምም። ኤርምያስ ለሕዝቡ ያለቅሳል፦ መከሩ አልፏል፤ እነርሱም አልዳኑም፤ በገለዓድም በለሳን የለም።

9.en: Jeremiah wishes his eyes were a fountain of tears for his people. No one should boast of wisdom or strength, but only of knowing God, who delights in loyal love, justice and righteousness.
9.sw: Yeremia anatamani macho yake yangekuwa chemchemi ya machozi kwa ajili ya watu wake. Hakuna anayepaswa kujivunia hekima au nguvu, bali kumjua Mungu tu, anayependezwa na upendo usiokoma, haki na uadilifu.
9.am: ኤርምያስ ዓይኖቹ ለሕዝቡ የእንባ ምንጭ ቢሆኑ ይመኛል። ማንም በጥበብ ወይም በብርታት ሊመካ አይገባውም፤ በጽኑ ፍቅር፣ በፍትሕና በጽድቅ ደስ የሚለውን እግዚአብሔርን በማወቅ ብቻ እንጂ።

10.en: Idols are like scarecrows in a cucumber field, but God is the true and living God. Jeremiah grieves over the coming exile and prays for correction with justice.
10.sw: Sanamu ni kama vitisha-ndege katika shamba la matango, lakini Mungu ni Mungu wa kweli na aliye hai. Yeremia anahuzunika juu ya uhamisho unaokuja na anaomba arudiwe kwa haki.
10.am: ጣዖታት በኪያር ማሳ እንዳለ ማስፈራሪያ ናቸው፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን እውነተኛና ሕያው አምላክ ነው። ኤርምያስ ስለሚመጣው ስደት ያዝናል፤ በፍትሕ እንዲገሠጽም ይጸልያል።

11.en: Judah has broken the covenant, so disaster will come. The men of Anathoth plot to kill Jeremiah, and God promises to punish them.
11.sw: Yuda imelivunja agano, kwa hiyo maafa yatakuja. Watu wa Anathothi wanapanga njama ya kumuua Yeremia, na Mungu anaahidi kuwaadhibu.
11.am: ይሁዳ ቃል ኪዳኑን አፍርሳለች፤ ስለዚህ ጥፋት ይመጣል። የዓናቶት ሰዎች ኤርምያስን ለመግደል ያሤራሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደሚቀጣቸው ተስፋ ይሰጣል።

12.en: Jeremiah asks why the wicked prosper, and God answers that worse is coming. God has abandoned the heritage but will have compassion on the nations that learn God's ways.
12.sw: Yeremia anauliza kwa nini waovu wanafanikiwa, na Mungu anajibu kwamba mabaya zaidi yanakuja. Mungu ameuacha urithi wake lakini atayahurumia mataifa yatakayojifunza njia za Mungu.
12.am: ኤርምያስ ክፉዎች ለምን እንደሚበለጽጉ ይጠይቃል፤ እግዚአብሔርም የባሰ ነገር እንደሚመጣ ይመልሳል። እግዚአብሔር ርስቱን ትቷል፤ ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ለሚማሩ ሕዝቦች ይራራል።

13.en: Jeremiah buries a linen loincloth until it is ruined, a sign of how God will ruin Judah's pride. Jars filled with wine picture the drunkenness of judgment.
13.sw: Yeremia anazika kitambaa cha kitani cha kiunoni mpaka kinaharibika, ishara ya jinsi Mungu atakavyoharibu kiburi cha Yuda. Mitungi iliyojazwa divai inaonyesha ulevi wa hukumu.
13.am: ኤርምያስ የበፍታ መታጠቂያውን እስኪበላሽ ድረስ ይቀብረዋል፤ ይህም እግዚአብሔር የይሁዳን ትዕቢት እንዴት እንደሚያበላሸው ምልክት ነው። በወይን ጠጅ የተሞሉ ማድጋዎች የፍርድን ስካር ያሳያሉ።

14.en: During a drought Jeremiah pleads for the people, but God forbids him to pray for them and condemns the prophets who promise peace.
14.sw: Wakati wa ukame Yeremia anawaombea watu, lakini Mungu anamkataza kuwaombea na anawahukumu manabii wanaoahidi amani.
14.am: በድርቅ ጊዜ ኤርምያስ ስለ ሕዝቡ ይማልዳል፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ስለ እነርሱ እንዳይጸልይ ይከለክለዋል፤ ሰላምን ተስፋ የሚሰጡትንም ነቢያት ይፈርድባቸዋል።

15.en: Even Moses and Samuel could not turn God's heart toward this people. Jeremiah laments his calling, and God promises to make him a wall of bronze if he returns.
15.sw: Hata Musa na Samweli wasingeweza kuugeuza moyo wa Mungu kwa watu hawa. Yeremia anaomboleza wito wake, na Mungu anaahidi kumfanya ukuta wa shaba akirudi.
15.am: ሙሴና ሳሙኤል እንኳ የእግዚአብሔርን ልብ ወደዚህ ሕዝብ ሊመልሱት አይችሉም። ኤርምያስ በጥሪው ያለቅሳል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ቢመለስ የነሐስ ቅጥር እንደሚያደርገው ተስፋ ይሰጠዋል።

16.en: Jeremiah must not marry or join in feasting or mourning, as a sign of coming disaster. God will one day bring the people back from all the lands.
16.sw: Yeremia hapaswi kuoa wala kujiunga na karamu au maombolezo, kama ishara ya maafa yanayokuja. Siku moja Mungu atawarudisha watu kutoka nchi zote.
16.am: ኤርምያስ ለሚመጣው ጥፋት ምልክት ሆኖ ሚስት ሊያገባ፣ በግብዣም ሆነ በልቅሶ ሊተባበር አይገባውም። አንድ ቀን እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ከምድር ሁሉ ይመልሳል።

17.en: Judah's sin is written on their hearts with an iron pen. The heart is more devious than anything else, and those who trust in people are cursed, but those who trust God are like a tree planted by water.
17.sw: Dhambi ya Yuda imeandikwa juu ya mioyo yao kwa kalamu ya chuma. Moyo una hila kuliko kitu kingine chochote, na wale wanaowatumainia wanadamu wamelaaniwa, lakini wale wanaomtumaini Mungu ni kama mti uliopandwa kando ya maji.
17.am: የይሁዳ ኃጢአት በልባቸው ላይ በብረት ብዕር ተጽፏል። ልብ ከማንኛውም ነገር የበለጠ ጠማማ ነው፤ በሰው የሚታመኑ የተረገሙ ናቸው፤ በእግዚአብሔር የሚታመኑ ግን በውኃ ዳር እንደ ተተከለ ዛፍ ናቸው።

18.en: At the potter's house God shows Jeremiah that God can reshape Israel as the potter reshapes the clay. The people plot against Jeremiah.
18.sw: Katika nyumba ya mfinyanzi Mungu anamwonyesha Yeremia kwamba Mungu anaweza kuwafinyanga upya Israeli kama mfinyanzi anavyoufinyanga upya udongo. Watu wanapanga njama dhidi ya Yeremia.
18.am: እግዚአብሔር በሸክላ ሠሪው ቤት ሸክላ ሠሪው ጭቃውን እንደ ገና እንደሚቀርጸው እግዚአብሔርም እስራኤልን እንደ ገና ሊቀርጽ እንደሚችል ለኤርምያስ ያሳየዋል። ሕዝቡ በኤርምያስ ላይ ያሤራሉ።

19.en: Jeremiah breaks a clay jar in the Valley of Ben-hinnom as a sign that God will smash Jerusalem.
19.sw: Yeremia anavunja mtungi wa udongo katika Bonde la Ben-hinomu kama ishara kwamba Mungu atavunja Yerusalemu.
19.am: ኤርምያስ እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን እንደሚሰባብራት ምልክት ሆኖ በሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ የሸክላ ማሰሮ ይሰብራል።

20.en: Pashhur the priest beats Jeremiah and puts him in the stocks. Jeremiah complains that God has deceived him, yet God's word is like a fire shut up in his bones, and he curses the day he was born.
20.sw: Pashuri kuhani anampiga Yeremia na kumtia katika mkatale. Yeremia analalamika kwamba Mungu amemshawishi, lakini neno la Mungu ni kama moto uliofungiwa ndani ya mifupa yake, na anailaani siku aliyozaliwa.
20.am: ካህኑ ፋስኮር ኤርምያስን ደብድቦ በግንድ ያስረዋል። ኤርምያስ እግዚአብሔር እንዳባበለው ያማርራል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ግን በአጥንቶቹ ውስጥ እንደ ተዘጋ እሳት ነው፤ የተወለደባትንም ቀን ይረግማል።

21.en: When Zedekiah asks for God's help against Babylon, Jeremiah answers that God will fight against Jerusalem. Those who surrender to the Babylonians will live.
21.sw: Sedekia anapoomba msaada wa Mungu dhidi ya Babeli, Yeremia anajibu kwamba Mungu atapigana dhidi ya Yerusalemu. Wale watakaojisalimisha kwa Wababeli wataishi.
21.am: ሴዴቅያስ በባቢሎን ላይ የእግዚአብሔርን ርዳታ ሲጠይቅ ኤርምያስ እግዚአብሔር በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ እንደሚዋጋ ይመልሳል። ለባቢሎናውያን እጃቸውን የሚሰጡ በሕይወት ይኖራሉ።

22.en: Jeremiah tells the kings of Judah to do justice and warns them of judgment. He pronounces judgment on Shallum, Jehoiakim and Jehoiachin.
22.sw: Yeremia anawaambia wafalme wa Yuda watende haki na anawaonya juu ya hukumu. Anatangaza hukumu juu ya Shalumu, Yehoyakimu na Yehoyakini.
22.am: ኤርምያስ የይሁዳ ነገሥታት ፍትሕን እንዲያደርጉ ይነግራቸዋል፤ ስለ ፍርድም ያስጠነቅቃቸዋል። በሰሎም፣ በኢዮአቄምና በዮአኪን ላይ ፍርድን ያውጃል።

23.en: God will judge the shepherds who scatter the flock and will raise up a righteous Branch for David. God condemns the lying prophets who speak their own dreams.
23.sw: Mungu atawahukumu wachungaji wanaolitawanya kundi na atamwinulia Daudi Chipukizi la haki. Mungu anawahukumu manabii waongo wanaosema ndoto zao wenyewe.
23.am: እግዚአብሔር መንጋውን በሚበትኑ እረኞች ላይ ይፈርዳል፤ ለዳዊትም ጻድቅ ቅርንጫፍ ያስነሣል። እግዚአብሔር የራሳቸውን ሕልም የሚናገሩ ሐሰተኛ ነቢያትን ይፈርድባቸዋል።

24.en: God shows Jeremiah two baskets of figs: the good figs are the exiles God will bring back, and the bad figs are those who stay in Jerusalem.
24.sw: Mungu anamwonyesha Yeremia vikapu viwili vya tini: tini nzuri ni wale walio uhamishoni ambao Mungu atawarudisha, na tini mbaya ni wale wanaobaki Yerusalemu.
24.am: እግዚአብሔር ለኤርምያስ ሁለት የበለስ ቅርጫቶችን ያሳየዋል፦ መልካሙ በለስ እግዚአብሔር የሚመልሳቸው ምርኮኞች ናቸው፤ መጥፎው በለስ ደግሞ በኢየሩሳሌም የሚቀሩት ናቸው።

25.en: Because Judah has not listened for twenty-three years, Babylon will rule them for seventy years. The nations must drink the cup of God's wrath.
25.sw: Kwa sababu Yuda haijasikiliza kwa miaka ishirini na mitatu, Babeli itawatawala kwa miaka sabini. Mataifa lazima wanywe kikombe cha ghadhabu ya Mungu.
25.am: ይሁዳ ለሃያ ሦስት ዓመት ስላልሰማች ባቢሎን ለሰባ ዓመት ትገዛቸዋለች። ሕዝቦች የእግዚአብሔርን የቍጣ ጽዋ መጠጣት አለባቸው።

26.en: Jeremiah is tried for prophesying against the temple, but the officials spare him. The prophet Uriah is killed for the same message.
26.sw: Yeremia anashtakiwa kwa kutabiri dhidi ya hekalu, lakini maafisa wanamwacha hai. Nabii Uria anauawa kwa ujumbe huohuo.
26.am: ኤርምያስ በቤተ መቅደሱ ላይ ትንቢት በመናገሩ ይከሰሳል፤ ሹማምንቱ ግን ያተርፉታል። ነቢዩ ኦርዮ በዚያው መልእክት ይገደላል።

27.en: Jeremiah wears a yoke and tells the kings to serve Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, warning against prophets who say otherwise.
27.sw: Yeremia anavaa nira na kuwaambia wafalme wamtumikie Nebukadneza wa Babeli, akiwaonya dhidi ya manabii wanaosema vinginevyo.
27.am: ኤርምያስ ቀንበር ተሸክሞ ነገሥታቱ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርን እንዲያገለግሉ ይነግራቸዋል፤ ሌላ ነገር ከሚናገሩ ነቢያትም ያስጠነቅቃቸዋል።

28.en: The prophet Hananiah breaks Jeremiah's yoke and promises a quick return from exile. Jeremiah announces that Hananiah will die, and he dies that year.
28.sw: Nabii Hanania anaivunja nira ya Yeremia na kuahidi kurudi upesi kutoka uhamishoni. Yeremia anatangaza kwamba Hanania atakufa, naye anakufa mwaka huohuo.
28.am: ነቢዩ ሐናንያ የኤርምያስን ቀንበር ሰብሮ ከስደት በቶሎ እንደሚመለሱ ተስፋ ይሰጣል። ኤርምያስ ሐናንያ እንደሚሞት ያውጃል፤ እርሱም በዚያው ዓመት ይሞታል።

29.en: Jeremiah writes to the exiles in Babylon to build houses, plant gardens and seek the peace of the city, for God has plans to give them a future and a hope after seventy years.
29.sw: Yeremia anawaandikia walio uhamishoni Babeli wajenge nyumba, wapande bustani na kutafuta amani ya mji, kwa maana Mungu amewapangia wakati ujao na tumaini baada ya miaka sabini.
29.am: ኤርምያስ በባቢሎን ላሉ ምርኮኞች ቤት እንዲሠሩ፣ አትክልት እንዲተክሉና የከተማዪቱን ሰላም እንዲሹ ይጽፍላቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ከሰባ ዓመት በኋላ የወደፊት ዘመንና ተስፋ እንዲሰጣቸው አቅዷልና።

30.en: God promises to restore the fortunes of Israel and Judah and bring them back to the land. Their wound is incurable, but God will heal it.
30.sw: Mungu anaahidi kuwarudishia Israeli na Yuda hali yao njema na kuwarudisha katika nchi. Jeraha lao haliponi, lakini Mungu atawaponya.
30.am: እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤልንና የይሁዳን ዕድል ፈንታ እንደሚመልስና ወደ ምድሪቱ እንደሚያመጣቸው ተስፋ ይሰጣል። ቍስላቸው የማይድን ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ይፈውሰዋል።

31.en: God's love for Israel is everlasting, and Rachel's weeping for her children will end. God will make a new covenant, writing the law on their hearts.
31.sw: Upendo wa Mungu kwa Israeli ni wa milele, na kilio cha Raheli kwa ajili ya watoto wake kitakoma. Mungu atafanya agano jipya, akiiandika sheria juu ya mioyo yao.
31.am: እግዚአብሔር ለእስራኤል ያለው ፍቅር ዘላለማዊ ነው፤ ራሔል ለልጆቿ የምታለቅሰው ለቅሶም ያበቃል። እግዚአብሔር ሕጉን በልባቸው ላይ እየጻፈ አዲስ ቃል ኪዳን ያደርጋል።

32.en: During the siege Jeremiah buys a field at Anathoth as a sign that houses and fields will again be bought in the land. God promises an everlasting covenant.
32.sw: Wakati wa kuzingirwa Yeremia ananunua shamba huko Anathothi kama ishara kwamba nyumba na mashamba yatanunuliwa tena katika nchi. Mungu anaahidi agano la milele.
32.am: በከበባው ጊዜ ኤርምያስ በምድሪቱ ቤቶችና እርሻዎች ዳግመኛ እንደሚገዙ ምልክት ሆኖ በዓናቶት እርሻ ይገዛል። እግዚአብሔር የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን ተስፋ ይሰጣል።

33.en: God promises to heal and restore Jerusalem and to raise up a righteous Branch for David. God's covenant with David and the Levites is as sure as day and night.
33.sw: Mungu anaahidi kuiponya na kuirejesha Yerusalemu na kumwinulia Daudi Chipukizi la haki. Agano la Mungu na Daudi na Walawi ni la hakika kama mchana na usiku.
33.am: እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን እንደሚፈውሳትና እንደሚያድሳት፣ ለዳዊትም ጻድቅ ቅርንጫፍ እንደሚያስነሣ ተስፋ ይሰጣል። እግዚአብሔር ከዳዊትና ከሌዋውያን ጋር ያደረገው ቃል ኪዳን እንደ ቀንና ሌሊት የጸና ነው።

34.en: Jeremiah tells Zedekiah that he will be taken to Babylon. The people free their Hebrew slaves and then take them back, and God condemns them.
34.sw: Yeremia anamwambia Sedekia kwamba atachukuliwa mpaka Babeli. Watu wanawaacha huru watumwa wao Waebrania kisha wanawarudisha, na Mungu anawahukumu.
34.am: ኤርምያስ ሴዴቅያስ ወደ ባቢሎን እንደሚወሰድ ይነግረዋል። ሕዝቡ ዕብራውያን ባሪያዎቻቸውን ነጻ ይለቃሉ፤ ከዚያም መልሰው ይይዟቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ይፈርድባቸዋል።

35.en: Jeremiah tests the Rechabites with wine, and they refuse because of their ancestor's command. Their faithfulness is set against Judah's disobedience.
35.sw: Yeremia anawajaribu Warekabu kwa divai, nao wanakataa kwa sababu ya amri ya babu yao. Uaminifu wao unalinganishwa na uasi wa Yuda.
35.am: ኤርምያስ ሬካባውያንን በወይን ጠጅ ይፈትናቸዋል፤ እነርሱም ስለ አባታቸው ትእዛዝ እምቢ ይላሉ። ታማኝነታቸው ከይሁዳ አለመታዘዝ ጋር ይነጻጸራል።

36.en: Baruch writes Jeremiah's words on a scroll and reads it in the temple. King Jehoiakim burns it piece by piece, and Jeremiah dictates it again.
36.sw: Baruku anaandika maneno ya Yeremia katika gombo na kulisoma hekaluni. Mfalme Yehoyakimu analichoma kipande baada ya kipande, na Yeremia analisoma tena ili liandikwe.
36.am: ባሮክ የኤርምያስን ቃል በጥቅልል ጽፎ በቤተ መቅደሱ ያነብበዋል። ንጉሥ ኢዮአቄም ቍራጭ በቍራጭ ያቃጥለዋል፤ ኤርምያስም እንደ ገና ያስጽፈዋል።

37.en: Jeremiah is arrested and imprisoned on a charge of deserting to the Babylonians. Zedekiah consults him secretly and keeps him in the courtyard of the guard.
37.sw: Yeremia anakamatwa na kufungwa gerezani kwa shtaka la kukimbilia kwa Wababeli. Sedekia anamwuliza kwa siri na kumweka katika ua wa walinzi.
37.am: ኤርምያስ ወደ ባቢሎናውያን ሊከዳ ነው በሚል ክስ ተይዞ ይታሰራል። ሴዴቅያስ በምስጢር ያማክረዋል፤ በዘበኞቹ አደባባይም ያኖረዋል።

38.en: The officials throw Jeremiah into a muddy cistern, and Ebed-melech the Cushite rescues him. Zedekiah again consults Jeremiah, who urges him to surrender.
38.sw: Maafisa wanamtupa Yeremia ndani ya birika lenye matope, na Ebed-meleki Mkushi anamwokoa. Sedekia anamwuliza Yeremia tena, naye anamhimiza ajisalimishe.
38.am: ሹማምንቱ ኤርምያስን ጭቃ ባለበት ጉድጓድ ውስጥ ይጥሉታል፤ ኩሻዊው አቤሜሌክም ያወጣዋል። ሴዴቅያስ ዳግመኛ ኤርምያስን ያማክረዋል፤ እርሱም እጁን እንዲሰጥ ያሳስበዋል።

39.en: Babylon captures Jerusalem, Zedekiah is blinded and taken captive, and the city is burned. Jeremiah is released, and Ebed-melech is promised safety.
39.sw: Babeli inaiteka Yerusalemu, Sedekia anapofushwa macho na kuchukuliwa mateka, na mji unachomwa. Yeremia anaachiliwa, na Ebed-meleki anaahidiwa usalama.
39.am: ባቢሎን ኢየሩሳሌምን ትይዛለች፤ ሴዴቅያስ ዓይኑ ታውሮ ተማርኮ ይወሰዳል፤ ከተማዪቱም ትቃጠላለች። ኤርምያስ ይፈታል፤ ለአቤሜሌክም ደኅንነት ተስፋ ይሰጠዋል።

40.en: Jeremiah stays with Gedaliah, the new governor at Mizpah. Gedaliah is warned of a plot against him but does not believe it.
40.sw: Yeremia anakaa pamoja na Gedalia, liwali mpya huko Mizpa. Gedalia anaonywa juu ya njama dhidi yake lakini haamini.
40.am: ኤርምያስ በምጽጳ ካለው አዲሱ ገዥ ከጎዶልያስ ጋር ይቀመጣል። ጎዶልያስ በእርሱ ላይ ስለ ተሸረበ ሤራ ቢነገረውም አያምንም።

41.en: Ishmael son of Nethaniah murders Gedaliah and many others. Johanan rescues the captives, and they plan to flee to Egypt.
41.sw: Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania anamuua Gedalia na wengine wengi. Yohana anawaokoa mateka, nao wanapanga kukimbilia Misri.
41.am: የናታንያ ልጅ እስማኤል ጎዶልያስንና ሌሎች ብዙዎችን ይገድላል። ዮሐናን ምርኮኞቹን ያስመልሳል፤ እነርሱም ወደ ግብፅ ለመሸሽ ያቅዳሉ።

42.en: The people ask Jeremiah to seek God's guidance, and God tells them to stay in the land and not go to Egypt.
42.sw: Watu wanamwomba Yeremia atafute mwongozo wa Mungu, na Mungu anawaambia wabaki katika nchi wasiende Misri.
42.am: ሕዝቡ ኤርምያስ የእግዚአብሔርን መመሪያ እንዲጠይቅላቸው ይለምኑታል፤ እግዚአብሔርም በምድሪቱ እንዲቀመጡ እንጂ ወደ ግብፅ እንዳይሄዱ ይነግራቸዋል።

43.en: The leaders accuse Jeremiah of lying and take the people, Jeremiah and Baruch to Egypt. In Tahpanhes Jeremiah foretells that Nebuchadnezzar will conquer Egypt.
43.sw: Viongozi wanamshtaki Yeremia kwa kusema uongo na kuwachukua watu, Yeremia na Baruku mpaka Misri. Huko Tahpanhesi Yeremia anatabiri kwamba Nebukadneza ataishinda Misri.
43.am: መሪዎቹ ኤርምያስን ሐሰት ይናገራል ብለው ይከሱታል፤ ሕዝቡን፣ ኤርምያስንና ባሮክንም ወደ ግብፅ ይወስዳሉ። በጣፍኔስ ኤርምያስ ናቡከደነፆር ግብፅን እንደሚያሸንፍ አስቀድሞ ይናገራል።

44.en: Jeremiah rebukes the Judeans in Egypt for burning incense to the queen of heaven, and they refuse to listen.
44.sw: Yeremia anawakemea Wayahudi walioko Misri kwa kumfukizia uvumba malkia wa mbinguni, nao wanakataa kusikiliza.
44.am: ኤርምያስ በግብፅ ያሉትን አይሁድ ለሰማይ ንግሥት ዕጣን በማጠናቸው ይገሥጻቸዋል፤ እነርሱም ለመስማት እምቢ ይላሉ።

45.en: God tells Baruch that he will escape with his life wherever he goes.
45.sw: Mungu anamwambia Baruku kwamba ataponyoka na maisha yake popote atakapokwenda.
45.am: እግዚአብሔር ባሮክ በሚሄድበት ሁሉ ሕይወቱን እንደሚያተርፍ ይነግረዋል።

46.en: Jeremiah announces that Babylon will defeat Egypt at Carchemish and invade the land.
46.sw: Yeremia anatangaza kwamba Babeli itaishinda Misri huko Karkemishi na kuivamia nchi.
46.am: ኤርምያስ ባቢሎን ግብፅን በከርከሚሽ እንደምታሸንፍና ምድሪቱንም እንደምትወር ያውጃል።

47.en: Jeremiah announces judgment on the Philistines.
47.sw: Yeremia anatangaza hukumu juu ya Wafilisti.

48.en: Jeremiah announces the destruction of Moab and its pride, with a promise of restoration in days to come.
48.sw: Yeremia anatangaza kuangamizwa kwa Moabu na kiburi chake, pamoja na ahadi ya kurejeshwa katika siku zijazo.
48.am: ኤርምያስ የሞዓብንና የትዕቢቷን ጥፋት ያውጃል፤ በሚመጡት ዘመናትም እንደምትታደስ ተስፋ ይሰጣል።

49.en: Oracles of judgment are given against Ammon, Edom, Damascus, Kedar, Hazor and Elam.
49.sw: Jumbe za hukumu zinatolewa dhidi ya Waamoni, Edomu, Dameski, Kedari, Hazori na Elamu.
49.am: በአሞናውያን፣ በኤዶም፣ በደማስቆ፣ በቄዳር፣ በአሶርና በኤላም ላይ የፍርድ ቃላት ይነገራሉ።

50.en: Babylon will fall to a nation from the north, and Israel and Judah will return to seek God.
50.sw: Babeli itaanguka kwa taifa kutoka kaskazini, na Israeli na Yuda watarudi kumtafuta Mungu.
50.am: ባቢሎን ከሰሜን በሚመጣ ሕዝብ ትወድቃለች፤ እስራኤልና ይሁዳም እግዚአብሔርን ለመፈለግ ይመለሳሉ።

51.en: God will bring destruction on Babylon and will repay her for what she did to Zion. Jeremiah's words are written on a scroll and sunk in the Euphrates.
51.sw: Mungu ataleta uharibifu juu ya Babeli na kumlipa kwa yale aliyoitendea Sayuni. Maneno ya Yeremia yanaandikwa katika gombo na kuzamishwa katika Frati.
51.am: እግዚአብሔር በባቢሎን ላይ ጥፋትን ያመጣል፤ በጽዮን ላይ ስላደረገችውም ይበቀላታል። የኤርምያስ ቃል በጥቅልል ተጽፎ በኤፍራጥስ ውስጥ ይሰጥማል።

52.en: Babylon besieges Jerusalem, Zedekiah is captured and the temple is burned. The exiles are counted, and in Babylon King Jehoiachin is released from prison.
52.sw: Babeli inaizingira Yerusalemu, Sedekia anakamatwa na hekalu linachomwa. Watu waliochukuliwa uhamishoni wanahesabiwa, na huko Babeli mfalme Yehoyakini anaachiliwa kutoka gerezani.
52.am: ባቢሎን ኢየሩሳሌምን ትከብባለች፤ ሴዴቅያስ ይያዛል፤ ቤተ መቅደሱም ይቃጠላል። ምርኮኞቹ ይቈጠራሉ፤ በባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ዮአኪን ከወህኒ ይፈታል።
